focuses.name: The Four-Year Plan
focuses.description: The new plan fixes production targets for four years and puts the state at the centre of investment. Autarky is the goal; rearmament is the instrument.
focuses.history: The plan tied industrial output to rearmament targets and made the state the largest customer in the economy.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Autarky Efforts
focuses.description: Substitute imported raw materials, ration foreign currency and stockpile what the Reich cannot produce at home.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Institute Price Controls
focuses.description: Fix prices, rents and wages to keep the rearmament boom from turning into open inflation.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Establish the Reichswerke
focuses.description: The Reichswerke Hermann Göring are built to exploit low-grade domestic ore and free the state from the private steel cartels.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Seize Foreign Industries
focuses.description: Bring foreign plants, mines and rolling mills under German control as the armies advance.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Coal Liquefaction
focuses.description: Coal liquefaction at Leuna and Pölitz is scaled up to supply fuel for a mechanised army without domestic oil.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Subsidize Hoesch-Benzin
focuses.description: Subsidies and guaranteed contracts keep the synthetic fuel programme alive when the private balance sheet turns red.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Establish Buna-Werke
focuses.description: Buna plants are built to produce synthetic rubber for tyres, aircraft and the motorised divisions.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Autarky Achieved
focuses.description: The Reich can now feed its factories from within its own sphere. The economy is ready for a long war.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Autarky and Synthetic Materials

focuses.name: Accelerate the Rearmament Program
focuses.description: The armed forces receive a fixed share of industrial output and a standing claim on skilled labour.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Concentrated Armament Program
focuses.description: Concentrate armament contracts in a small number of large combines and give them priority for steel and machine tools.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Establish Production Targets
focuses.description: Quotas, bonuses and production schedules are imposed on every plant that works for the armed forces.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Form the Zentrale Planung
focuses.description: A central planning board coordinates the ministries, the army and industry under one set of priorities.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Armament Rationalization
focuses.description: Standardise components and production methods so that the same plant can switch between weapons without losing weeks.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Create the Rüstungsstab
focuses.description: An armaments staff is created to allocate contracts, resolve bottlenecks and report directly to the leadership.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Totaler Krieg
focuses.description: The entire economy is placed on a war footing. Civilian production is cut to the minimum and every factory is put under military direction.
focuses.history: Total war was declared only after the tide had turned, when the economy had already been strained by years of bombing.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Prioritize Economic Growth
focuses.description: A competing economic programme favours consumption, private construction and exports. It rejects the command targets of the Four-Year Plan.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Currency Reforms
focuses.description: Replace the improvised bills of the rearmament years with a controlled currency and a clear schedule for repayment.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Lower Taxes
focuses.description: Reduce the tax burden on workers and small businesses so that domestic demand can absorb the slack in the economy.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Housing Developments
focuses.description: Subsidise housing construction and public works to create jobs and calm the cities.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Abolish Price Controls
focuses.description: Dismantle the price and rationing system, allowing businesses to invest and consumers to spend.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Industrial Expansion
focuses.description: Expand the consumer industries and the machine-tool sector that supplies them.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Worker's Rights
focuses.description: Recognise reformed unions and works councils in exchange for wage restraint and labour peace.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Increased Trade
focuses.description: Open trade negotiations with the smaller European economies and secure long-term supply contracts.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Invest in Vereinigte Stahlwerke
focuses.description: Invest in the Vereinigte Stahlwerke and the private steel industry instead of building a state-owned competitor.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Agricultural Reforms
focuses.description: Modernise farms, guarantee prices and slow the flight from the land.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Wirtschaftswunder
focuses.description: The economy has recovered faster than anyone expected. The state can now afford both rearmament and a higher standard of living.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Mass Production
focuses.description: Move from craft production to long production runs with interchangeable parts and dedicated assembly lines.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: Build a Defense Industry
focuses.description: Build a permanent defence industry that can survive the end of a single armament programme.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Currency and Industry

focuses.name: War Production
focuses.description: Convert the recovered civilian economy to wartime output without losing the industrial base that made it possible.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Urbanization
focuses.description: Grow the great cities and the industrial belts around them, creating a permanent skilled workforce.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Welfare and Economic Miracle

focuses.name: Construct the Reichsautobahn
focuses.description: The motorway network is extended across the Reich, linking the industrial west to the agricultural east.
focuses.history: The motorway programme was the most visible public works project of the decade and a model for wartime logistics.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Build the Rur Dam
focuses.description: Hydroelectric and water-management works in the Ruhr support the mines, the steel mills and the growing cities.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: KdF-Wagen Factories
focuses.description: A state-backed automobile plant puts a cheap car within reach of the German household and creates a reserve of motor production.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Expand the Reichsautobahn South
focuses.description: Extend the motorway south toward the Alps so that troops and supplies can move quickly to the Austrian and Italian frontiers.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Develop Heraeus Research Facilities
focuses.description: Fund the Heraeus laboratories and secure a domestic supply of the specialist metals needed for electronics and precision instruments.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Expand the Reichsautobahn East
focuses.description: Push the motorway east toward Prussia, binding the exposed eastern provinces to the rest of the Reich.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Trade Deal with Sweden
focuses.description: Trade machine tools and coal for Swedish iron ore, keeping the northern supply route open.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare
focuses.description: The army adopts a doctrine of movement, radio coordination and concentrated force. The static infantry army of the treaty years is abandoned.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Army Innovations

focuses.name: Fortify the Vaterland
focuses.description: Fortify the western frontier and prepare a defensive shield while the mobile forces are rebuilt.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: The Prussian Legacy
focuses.description: The officer corps returns to the Prussian tradition of initiative, mission command and rigorous staff work.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Adopt New Panzer Doctrine
focuses.description: Tanks are concentrated in independent divisions with their own infantry, artillery and supply. Guderian's ideas become doctrine.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Improve the Motorized Troops
focuses.description: Motorise the infantry and the supply columns so that the army can keep pace with its armoured spearheads.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Lessons of the Great War
focuses.description: Study the battles of the Great War and turn their lessons into a new field manual.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Artillery Bombardment
focuses.description: Concentrate artillery at the decisive point and train forward observers to direct fire in real time.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Stormtroopers
focuses.description: Specialist assault battalions are trained to break fortified positions at close range.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: All-Terrain Military Motorcycle
focuses.description: Motorcycle battalions give the advance guards speed, reconnaissance and a small logistical footprint.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Instill Auftragstaktik
focuses.description: Officers are trained to act on the commander's intent rather than wait for orders. Initiative becomes the standard.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Establish the Afrikakorps
focuses.description: A mobile force is prepared for desert warfare, where supply lines and heat are as dangerous as the enemy.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Panzergrenadier
focuses.description: Armoured infantry ride with the tanks and can fight dismounted once the breakthrough is made.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Nationalize Ford Factories
focuses.description: The Ford plants are placed under state control and turned over to trucks, tractors and spare parts.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Improve the Logistics System
focuses.description: Improve the supply services, repair depots and railway unloading points that keep a mobile army moving.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Defend the Vaterland
focuses.description: Prepare a defence in depth for the homeland, with fortified towns and mobile reserves.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Uranverein
focuses.description: Bring the physicists and engineers of the Uranverein together to study nuclear fission and its military potential.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Kriegslokomotiven
focuses.description: Standardise locomotives and rolling stock so that the railways can carry the army's growing tonnage.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Establish the Skijäger
focuses.description: Form light ski troops for the northern forests and the winter fronts.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Infantry, Officers and Logistics

focuses.name: Salvage Captured Equipment
focuses.description: Create workshops that recover, repair and reissue captured equipment instead of leaving it on the battlefield.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Panzer Troops School
focuses.description: A dedicated armoured school trains crews, maintenance teams and officers for the new divisions.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Advanced Panzer Research
focuses.description: Fund advanced armour, gun and engine research so that the next generation of tanks is ready before the enemy's.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Expand Kummersdorf's Capacity
focuses.description: Expand the Kummersdorf proving ground and give the designers room to test prototypes under realistic conditions.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Combined Arms
focuses.description: Infantry, armour and air power are trained to fight as one formation. The breakthrough is only the beginning of the operation.
focuses.history: The doctrine depended on signals, air superiority and logistics as much as on tanks. When those failed, the campaigns stopped.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Bribe Senior Officers
focuses.description: Buy the loyalty of the senior officer corps with promotions, estates and tax exemptions.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Army Indoctrination
focuses.description: Political education is introduced into the ranks so that the ordinary soldier fights for the regime, not merely for the country.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Strafbataillon
focuses.description: Penal battalions are formed from prisoners and disciplinary cases and sent to the most dangerous sectors.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Autonomy in the Kriegsschulen
focuses.description: The war academies keep their professional autonomy and train officers to think for themselves.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Expand the Truppenschulen
focuses.description: Expand the branch schools and the specialist training that produces engineers, signals officers and staff officers.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Innovative Warfare
focuses.description: Encourage experiments with new tactics, new equipment and new ways of organising the battlefield.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Reorganize Secret Services
focuses.description: Remove the old intelligence chief, reorganise the Abwehr and give the service a clear mandate.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Subversive Infiltrators
focuses.description: Train infiltrators and agents to work inside foreign governments, unions and colonial administrations.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Bribe Senior Officers and Secret Services

focuses.name: Expanding the Luftwaffe
focuses.description: The Luftwaffe becomes an independent service with its own staff, schools and industrial priority.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Air Innovations

focuses.name: Aeronautical Research Institute
focuses.description: Fund the aeronautical research institutes and the wind tunnels that support modern aircraft design.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Air Innovations

focuses.name: Dive Bombers
focuses.description: Dive bombers are built as flying artillery, able to hit bridges, columns and fortifications with precision.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Tactical Bombers
focuses.description: Tactical bombers attack enemy airfields, supply lines and troop concentrations behind the front.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Uralbomber Program
focuses.description: A long-range bomber programme is started to reach the factories of the Urals and, eventually, America.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Rocketry Innovations
focuses.description: Rocket propulsion is developed for aircraft, missiles and the long-range weapons of the future.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Air Innovations

focuses.name: Fallschirmjäger
focuses.description: Paratroopers are trained to seize bridges, airfields and fortified points before the main army arrives.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Form the Jagdwaffe
focuses.description: A fighter arm is built around modern interceptors, radar direction and experienced pilots.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Reorganize the Luftwaffe
focuses.description: Reorganise the air staff and the flying formations into a single command with clear priorities.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Solve the Logistical Bottlenecks
focuses.description: Fix the shortages of spare parts, fuel and trained ground crews that keep aircraft on the ground.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Experimental Rotorcrafts
focuses.description: Experimental rotorcraft are developed for reconnaissance, liaison and rescue work.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Defense of the Reich
focuses.description: Build a defensive air system over the Reich: radar, fighters, anti-aircraft guns and civil defence.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Construct the Kammhuber Line
focuses.description: A line of radar stations and night-fighter boxes is built across the western approaches.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Establish Night Fighter Squadrons
focuses.description: Night-fighter squadrons are equipped with radar and trained to intercept bombers in darkness.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Aerodynamic Research Institute
focuses.description: A new aerodynamic research institute pushes the limits of speed, range and altitude.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Air Innovations

focuses.name: Amerikabomber
focuses.description: A very long-range bomber is designed to threaten the American continent and the Atlantic sea lanes.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Develop the Knickebein
focuses.description: A radio navigation system is deployed to guide bombers to their targets in bad weather and at night.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Fighter and Defense

focuses.name: Torpedobomber
focuses.description: Torpedo bombers are added to the air arm to attack shipping and support naval operations.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine
focuses.description: The navy is expanded under the naval agreement with Britain, with new ships, docks and schools.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Plan Z
focuses.description: A ten-year programme of battleships, carriers and cruisers is approved to challenge British command of the sea.
focuses.history: The naval programme was designed for a war that was expected in the mid-1940s. It never received the time or steel it needed.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Expand the Kriegsmarinewerft
focuses.description: Expand the naval shipyards and the supporting steel, armour and engine industries.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Construct Aircraft Carriers
focuses.description: Lay down aircraft carriers and train the crews needed to operate them.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Establish Carrier Groups
focuses.description: Organise the carriers into balanced task groups with escorts, submarines and naval aircraft.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Grosskampfschiff Construction
focuses.description: Build the heavy ships that will form the core of the battle fleet.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: The High Seas Fleet
focuses.description: Concentrate the fleet into a force capable of challenging the enemy in the North Sea and the Atlantic.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Plan Z

focuses.name: Re-establish the Seekriegsleitung
focuses.description: Re-establish the naval command staff and give it direct access to the operational leadership.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Naval Command

focuses.name: Form the Marine Stosstrupp
focuses.description: Naval shock troops are trained for landings, raids and the seizure of coastal defences.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Naval Command

focuses.name: Atlantic Naval Bases
focuses.description: Build naval bases, coastal batteries and supply depots along the Atlantic coast.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Naval Command

focuses.name: Atlantic Naval Dominance
focuses.description: Turn the Atlantic coast into a chain of fortified bases from which the fleet can operate.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Naval Command

focuses.name: Trade Interdiction
focuses.description: Abandon the battle fleet and build a navy designed to attack trade: submarines, raiders and long-range aircraft.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: Cruiser Warfare
focuses.description: Armoured cruisers and fast raiders are sent into the open ocean to hunt merchant shipping.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: Panzerschiff Raiders
focuses.description: Pocket battleships and heavy cruisers combine speed, range and enough firepower to overwhelm a convoy escort.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: Wolfpack Tactics
focuses.description: Submarine groups are trained to attack convoys together, guided by radio intelligence.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: U-Boat Efforts
focuses.description: Mass-produce submarines and train crews faster than the enemy can replace lost merchant tonnage.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: Unrestricted Convoy Raiding
focuses.description: Coordination between submarines, aircraft and surface raiders turns the whole ocean into a hunting ground.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — U-Boat War

focuses.name: Seeherrschaft
focuses.description: The navy is ready to dispute control of the sea in every theatre where German troops can be supplied.
focuses.branchName: Strengthen the Kriegsmarine — Naval Command

focuses.name: Remilitarize the Rhineland
focuses.description: Reoccupy the demilitarised western zone and present Europe with a fait accompli. The army has orders to withdraw if France mobilises.
focuses.history: The demilitarised zone was created by the 1919 settlement. Reoccupying it was the first open breach of that order.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: War Preparations
focuses.description: Prepare the railways, hospitals and supply depots for a general European war.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Reorganize the Wehrmacht
focuses.description: Bring the army, navy and air force under a single high command and a unified war plan.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Heed von Neurath's Concerns
focuses.description: Keep the foreign ministry in civilian hands and avoid provoking the western powers before the army is ready.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Legion Condor
focuses.description: Send volunteers and aircraft to Spain to support the Nationalists and test the new air doctrine.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Legion Condor

focuses.name: Anschluss
focuses.description: Bring Austria into the Reich through pressure, a plebiscite and the threat of invasion.
focuses.history: A customs union with Austria was attempted in 1931 and blocked by the great powers. The second attempt would not be blocked.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Support a Coup in Liechtenstein
focuses.description: Support a friendly coup in Liechtenstein and absorb the principality into the Reich.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Legion Condor

focuses.name: Demand Sudetenland
focuses.description: Demand the German-speaking districts of Czechoslovakia after a fabricated crisis in Prague.
focuses.history: The conference that settled the Sudetenland in 1938 excluded the state whose territory was being divided.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: First Vienna Award
focuses.description: Arbitrate the Hungarian and Polish claims on Czechoslovakia in Germany's favour.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Reassert Eastern Claims
focuses.description: Demand the return of Danzig and the Polish Corridor, and prepare the army for a campaign in the east.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Fate of Czechoslovakia
focuses.description: Divide the remainder of Czechoslovakia into a German protectorate and a dependent Slovak state.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Danzig for Slovakia
focuses.description: Trade German support for a Slovak state against Polish agreement on Danzig and the Corridor.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Danzig or War
focuses.description: Settle the status of the Free City and the Corridor by force if Warsaw refuses.
focuses.history: The corridor was the most visible territorial clause of the 1919 settlement. Its revision triggered the 1939 campaign.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Befriend Poland
focuses.description: Offer Poland a place in the German sphere in exchange for Danzig and a common frontier against the Soviet Union.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Subjugate Romanian Economy
focuses.description: Pull the Danubian states into the German economy and secure their oil, grain and chrome.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Legion Condor

focuses.name: Mitteleuropa
focuses.description: Organise the smaller European states into a German-led economic and political bloc.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Legion Condor

focuses.name: Influence the Benelux
focuses.description: Bring the Low Countries into the German orbit through trade, pressure and political subversion.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Around Maginot
focuses.description: Plan an attack through the Low Countries to bypass the Maginot Line and strike France from the north.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Operation Weserübung
focuses.description: Prepare the occupation of Denmark and Norway to secure the northern supply route and the Swedish iron ore.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: War With France
focuses.description: Turn west and settle the account with France. The campaign must be short or the economy will not survive it.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Operation Sea Lion
focuses.description: Prepare an invasion of Britain across the Channel, with air superiority and a improvised fleet of barges.
focuses.history: The invasion of Britain depended on air superiority, a improvised fleet and a supply system that did not exist.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Operation Green
focuses.description: Operation Green advances the Remilitarize the Rhineland programme. Each diplomatic crisis is used to revise the settlement of 1919 and expand German power.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Demonstration of Military Achievements
focuses.description: Use parades, exercises and published reports to demonstrate the army's new strength.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: German Army, Invincible
focuses.description: The army's victories are presented as proof that the new doctrine and the new regime are unstoppable.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: The Supreme Leader
focuses.description: The leader's personal authority is elevated above the party and the army, creating a permanent cult of command.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Demand Slovenia
focuses.description: Demand the Slovenian border districts from Yugoslavia and prepare for a wider Balkan settlement.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Balkans

focuses.name: First Ljubljana Award
focuses.description: Impose an award on Yugoslavia that transfers the border districts to Germany and its allies.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Balkans

focuses.name: Fate of Yugoslavia
focuses.description: Break Yugoslavia apart and divide its territory between Germany, Italy, Hungary and Bulgaria.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Balkans

focuses.name: Second Ljubljana Award
focuses.description: Use a second award to settle the remaining border questions with Italy and Hungary.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Balkans

focuses.name: War With Greece
focuses.description: Invade Greece to secure the southern Balkans and deny Britain an airbase in the Aegean.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Balkans

focuses.name: Operation Tannenbaum
focuses.description: Prepare a campaign against Switzerland to secure its gold, industry and Alpine passes.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Pact of Steel
focuses.description: Convert the understanding with Italy into a formal military alliance with automatic consultation.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Anti-Comintern Pact
focuses.description: Build a bloc of states opposed to Moscow, offering arms and instructors in exchange for alignment.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact
focuses.description: Buy neutrality in the east with a secret partition protocol and a trade agreement.
focuses.history: The pact shocked every foreign ministry in Europe. It removed the two-front problem for one campaign.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Anti-Soviet Pact
focuses.description: Turn the Anti-Comintern Pact into a military coalition committed to war with the Soviet Union.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Befriend China
focuses.description: Support China against Japan and use the connection to regain a foothold in East Asia.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: War with the USSR
focuses.description: Prepare the eastern campaign: one theatre plan, one mobilisation wave and no separate negotiations.
focuses.history: The plan assumed the eastern campaign would be decided in weeks and that supply services would catch up afterwards.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Befriend Turkey
focuses.description: Offer Turkey arms, credit and a share of the Balkan settlement in exchange for alignment.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Re-Establish German Control over Qingdao
focuses.description: Negotiate the return of the old German leasehold at Qingdao and the surrounding railway zone.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Befriend Japan
focuses.description: Align with Japan and agree on spheres of influence in Asia and Europe.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: The Final Blow to Communism
focuses.description: The anti-Soviet coalition is ready to destroy the Soviet state and divide its territory.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Reclaim Former African Colonies
focuses.description: Demand the return of the former German colonies and prepare a new colonial administration.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Ally Chiang Kai-Shek
focuses.description: Turn the Chinese connection into a formal alliance and a market for German arms.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Mittelafrika
focuses.description: Plan a German-dominated central African empire built on the old colonial territories and their resources.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: The Proud Eagle and the Resurgent Dragon
focuses.description: A global network of alignments, from the Danube to the Yellow Sea, gives Germany partners on every continent.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Anti-Comintern Pact

focuses.name: Führerprinzip
focuses.description: The leadership principle is codified: the leader's will is the source of law, and the party becomes the state.
focuses.history: The leadership principle fused party and state and made the inner circle the real arena of political competition.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reichsleiter Todt
focuses.description: Fritz Todt is brought into the inner circle and given responsibility for construction and armaments.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Form Organization Todt
focuses.description: The Organization Todt is formed to build fortifications, roads and bridges with military discipline.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Autonomous Organization Todt
focuses.description: Give Todt an autonomous construction empire with its own labour force, budget and priorities.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reichsleiter Speer
focuses.description: Albert Speer is promoted as the technocrat who can rationalise the war economy.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Employ Philipp Holzmann
focuses.description: Bring the construction firm Philipp Holzmann into the armaments network and give it priority contracts.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Plenipotentiary of Armaments
focuses.description: Appoint a plenipotentiary for armaments with the power to override ministries and private cartels.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Wonder Weapons
focuses.description: Fund rockets, jet aircraft and other advanced weapons as a way to change the course of the war.
focuses.history: The wonder-weapon programme consumed scarce resources and produced few weapons in time to change the war.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reichsleiter Göring
focuses.description: Hermann Göring is given a place in the inner circle and control of the Four-Year Plan.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Plenipotentiary of the Four Year Plan
focuses.description: Make Göring the plenipotentiary of the Four-Year Plan, with authority over the whole war economy.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Integration of Puppet Economies
focuses.description: Integrate the economies of occupied and satellite states into a single German war economy.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reichsleiter Himmler
focuses.description: Heinrich Himmler enters the inner circle and begins to expand the SS from a party militia into a state within the state.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Expand Gestapo
focuses.description: Expand the secret police and give it a free hand against political opponents.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Absorb the Abwehr
focuses.description: Absorb the military intelligence service into the SS security apparatus.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Expand SS Security Duties
focuses.description: Give the SS responsibility for security, policing and the administration of occupied territory.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Strengthen the Waffen-SS
focuses.description: Expand the armed SS into full divisions that can fight alongside the army.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Hegemony of the SS
focuses.description: The SS becomes the dominant security and military institution of the regime.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reichsleiter Goebbels
focuses.description: Joseph Goebbels joins the inner circle and takes control of the national propaganda machine.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Ministry of Public Enlightenment
focuses.description: Centralise press, film, radio and culture under a single ministry with a monopoly on the national narrative.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Glorify Party Rallies
focuses.description: Mass rallies and party ceremonies bind the young generation to the regime.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Optimize Reich Labour Service
focuses.description: The labour service is expanded into a national institution that combines work, discipline and welfare.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: German Labour Front
focuses.description: The German Labour Front takes over leisure, health and welfare programmes for the working population.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Reorganize the Reich Research Council
focuses.description: The research councils and technical academies are reorganised around the armaments programme.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Total Control Over Domestic Affairs
focuses.description: The party takes control of every workplace, neighbourhood and association, leaving no independent public sphere.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: A Strong Successor
focuses.description: A strong successor is chosen from the inner circle, and the regime is prepared for the post-war order.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Loyalty to the Führer
focuses.description: Loyalty to the Führer advances the Führerprinzip programme. The inner circle competes for the leader's favour while the state is rebuilt around the party.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Führerprinzip

focuses.name: Extra Research Slot
focuses.description: The KdF-Wagen programme frees engineering capacity for an additional national research cell. A permanent fourth desk is added to the Reich research organisation.
focuses.branchName: Prioritize Economic Growth — Construct the Reichsautobahn

focuses.name: Army Innovations I
focuses.description: The army establishes a permanent programme of trials, war games and technical liaison with industry. Promising designs are pushed from the drawing board into field service.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Army Innovations

focuses.name: Army Innovations II
focuses.description: The first results are folded into divisional doctrine. New vehicles, radios and anti-tank weapons are tested together instead of as separate projects.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Army Innovations

focuses.name: Soviet-German Military Agreement
focuses.description: Officers and technical data are exchanged with the Red Army. The agreement opens a source of foreign experience while keeping the political relationship carefully limited.
focuses.history: The Reichswehr and the Red Army cooperated secretly in the 1920s and early 1930s, testing weapons and tactics away from the inspectors of Versailles.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Army Innovations

focuses.name: Air Innovations I
focuses.description: A central technical office coordinates aircraft design, engine development and flight testing. The Luftwaffe stops treating each new type as an isolated experiment.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Air Innovations

focuses.name: Tactical Air Effort
focuses.description: Close air support and battlefield interdiction become a permanent part of army operations. Air liaison officers are attached to every field headquarters.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Strategic Air Effort
focuses.description: Long-range bombers and navigation aids receive priority. The Luftwaffe prepares to strike enemy industry and transport far beyond the battlefield.
focuses.branchName: Expanding the Luftwaffe — Bomber Effort

focuses.name: Begin Depression Recovery
focuses.description: The Reich begins the long reconstruction of an economy shattered by depression and rearmament.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Appoint Economic Positions
focuses.description: Place reliable administrators in the ministries that control prices, labour and industrial quotas.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Two-Sided Economics
focuses.description: Balance civilian consumption against the demands of the arms programme without letting either collapse.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Support the Technocrats
focuses.description: Give engineers and statisticians authority over production targets and industrial modernisation.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Support the Autarks
focuses.description: Favour domestic raw materials, synthetic substitutes and the powerful autarky lobby.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Wunderwaffe
focuses.description: Concentrate scarce research capacity on weapons that might change the course of a long war.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Jet Research
focuses.description: Fund high-speed aircraft development before the older propeller designs are exhausted.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Establish Peenemünde
focuses.description: Turn the Baltic research station into a permanent centre for rockets, guidance and long-range weapons.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Total War
focuses.description: Put the entire economy on a war footing and subordinate civilian production to the front.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Volkssturm
focuses.description: Raise a national militia from the young, the old and those outside the regular replacement pool.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Enigma
focuses.description: Expand the signals service and its cipher network to protect operational planning.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: Reform the Uranprojekt
focuses.description: Reorganise atomic research under a single programme with clear military priorities.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Armament and Total War

focuses.name: West Wall
focuses.description: Extend fortifications along the western frontier while the diplomatic crises unfold.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Prepare the Invasion of France
focuses.description: Draft the operational plans, rail schedules and supply depots for a campaign in the west.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Blitzkrieg Tactics
focuses.description: Concentrate armour and air power at the decisive point instead of spreading them along the front.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Build the Panzer Army
focuses.description: Give the armoured divisions priority in steel, engines and trained crews.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: War with France
focuses.description: The western campaign begins; the old enemy must be defeated before the war turns east.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Around the Maginot Line
focuses.description: Avoid the fixed fortifications and drive through the Low Countries into the French interior.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Case Anton
focuses.description: Occupy the unoccupied zone of France and secure the Mediterranean coast.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Prepare the Invasion of Poland
focuses.description: Concentrate forces in Pomerania and Silesia for a short, decisive campaign in the east.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact
focuses.description: Divide eastern Europe into spheres of influence and buy time before the Soviet confrontation.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: War with Poland
focuses.description: Launch the eastern campaign and settle the Danzig question by force.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Invasion of the Soviet Union
focuses.description: Turn the accumulated planning and mobile forces against the Soviet Union.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Rhineland and Anschluss

focuses.name: Landing Craft
focuses.description: Build specialised craft and train crews for a landing on the British coast.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Train Marines
focuses.description: Prepare amphibious infantry for the first wave and the beachhead.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Train Paratroopers
focuses.description: Expand airborne formations to seize bridges, ports and airfields ahead of the landing.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Enact Operation Sea Lion
focuses.description: Commit the assembled fleet and landing forces to the invasion of Britain.
focuses.branchName: Remilitarize the Rhineland — Operation Sea Lion

focuses.name: Train Panzergrenadiers
focuses.description: Integrate motorised infantry into the panzer divisions so the mobile spearheads keep their momentum.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Counter Sloped Armor
focuses.description: Develop guns and ammunition that can defeat the sloped armour appearing on enemy tanks.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: Encirclement Doctrine
focuses.description: Train commanders to close the pocket and destroy encircled forces rather than merely push them back.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Panzer and Mobile Warfare

focuses.name: The Reich at the Crossroads
focuses.description: The old order has lost its authority. Before industry, the army or the parties can set a course, the Reich must decide who will direct the nation.
focuses.history: A deliberately broad opening focus: every later programme is presented as an answer to the same constitutional crisis.
focuses.branchName: The Reich at the Crossroads

focuses.name: Convene the Economic Council
focuses.description: Bring the great industrialists, the labour ministry and the state planners into one room. The council turns the contest over economic policy into a single national programme.
focuses.history: A coordinating body intended to bridge the Four-Year Plan and the liberal growth programme without deciding between them in advance.
focuses.branchName: The Four-Year Plan — Economic Council

focuses.name: Reorganize the Armed Forces
focuses.description: The service branches have competing doctrines, budgets and chains of command. A unified command prepares the ground for the army, air force, navy and expansion programmes.
focuses.history: The opening military decision of the campaign: a single command structure before the individual service doctrines branch apart.
focuses.branchName: Develop Modern Maneuver Warfare — Armed Forces Command
